user.title: Infoclimat Station
user.description: Enter the 5-character StatIC identifier of the station to monitor (for example `000FU`). You may also paste the address of its Infoclimat page.

data_description.station_id: Visible in the station URL on infoclimat.fr: …/temps-reel/station-name/000FU.html
data_description.scan_interval: Between 5 and 60 minutes. Infoclimat publishes a reading every 10 minutes.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach infoclimat.fr. Check your network connection.
error.cannot_parse: The station page could not be parsed. The website may have changed its structure.
error.invalid_station_id: Invalid identifier: 5 letters or digits expected (for example 000FU).
error.station_without_data: This station publishes no real-time data. Check its identifier.
error.rate_limited: Infoclimat blocked the automated requests (anti-robot page) and did not return the station. Wait a few minutes and try again, or increase the update interval.
